description: Run the full Technical Architecture Sanity Check on YOUR intake and return the verdict summary + report links (PDF/DOCX/HTML/Markdown/JSON). Costs ONE run credit: pass 'credit' (a web run-credit id) or 'api_key' (a key with balance). The intake is the SanityCheckIntakeV1 object (sections a-g; schema at https://sanity.aimlds.org/api/v1/intake-schema). Never include credentials in an intake — credential-shaped values are refused.

intake.description: SanityCheckIntakeV1 — sections a (context), b (architecture), c (spend bands), d (data flows), e (AI), f (security posture), g (pain).
